violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: - OBSERVED: (1) cut lettuce (48f) and mixed salad greens (46f) were stored in Economy 1-door upright cooler overnight; (2) cream cheese (47f), sliced cheddar cheese (47f), sliced American cheese (45f), sliced pepper jack cheese (45f), and sliced provolone cheese (45f) were stored in 1-door cooler (broiler) overnight; (3) cream cheese (51f) was stored in 1-door cooler (beverage, grey) overnight.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM discarded the food items.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: - OBSERVED: sliced cheddar cheese (47f), sliced American cheese (45f), sliced pepper jack cheese (45f), and sliced provolone cheese (45f) were prepared on 7/7/2026. By the time of inspection, these food items have been stored in 1-door cooler (broiler) for more than 7 days.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM discarded the abovementioned food items.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: Chinese five spicy tuna (the common lunch and dinner menu).
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: please asterisk the abovementioned food item.

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: all American breakfast (high table breakfast).
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: please provide a consumer advisory for the abovementioned food item.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: - OBSERVED: ambient temperature of Economy 1-door upright cooler (dessert) at 43f, 1-door cooler (broiler) at 43f, and 1-door cooler (beverage, grey) at 48f.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: please obtain urgent service for the abovementioned units within 10 calendar days.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip OR PLATE SIMULATING DISHWASHER TESTER available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. A PLATE SIMULATING DISHWASHER TESTER HAS BEEN ORDERED FROM ECOLAB.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED A CHEMICAL MIXING DISPENSER IS CONNECTED DOWNSTREAM FROM A MOP SINK WITH AN ATMOSPHERIC BREAKER THROUGH AN UNAPPROVED SPLITTER.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. CFM ORDERED AN APPROVED SPLITTER FROM ECOLAB.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. THE PERSON IN CHARGE IS NOT A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER (CFM).
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: UTENSILS WERE STORED IN A CONTAINER OF STAGNANT WATER AT 87F.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC DISCARDED THE WATER.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed food supply stored on milk crates for elevation ab ove the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Warewashing Equipment Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: The interior surfaces of the mechanical warewashing machine are soiled with heavy buildup of limescale that may decrease the effectiveness of the machine.
violations.corrective_action: A warewashing machine, the compartments of sinks, basins, or other receptacles used for washing and rinsing equipment, utensils, or raw foods, or laundering wiping cloths and drainboards or other equipment used to substitute for drainboards shall be cleaned before use, throughout the day at a frequency necessary to prevent recontamination of equipment and utensils and to ensure that the equipment performs its intended function and if used at least every 24 hours. Delime the interior of the machine More frequently.

violations.title: Warewashing Machine Operated per Data Plate
violations.observation: The mechanical warewashing machine was not operating in accordance with the manufacturer's specifications. THE LOW TEMPERATURE CHEMICAL WARE WASHING MACHINE WAS NOT SANITIZING UTENSILS AND EQUIPMENT. THE CHLORINE CONCENTRATION WAS NOTED TO BE ZERO DURING OPERATION.
violations.corrective_action: A warewashing machine and its auxiliary components shall be operated in accordance with the machine's data plate and other manufacturer's instructions. THE MACHINE SHOU,D BE ABLE TO PROVIDE A MINIMUM OF 50 PPM OF CHLORINE DURING OPERATION, ACCORDING TO THE DATA PLATE. MAKE THE NECESSARY ADJUSTMENTS IMMEDIATELY. DO NOT USE THE MACHINE UNTIL IT HAS BEEN REPAIRED AND ABLE TO SANITIZE ACCORDINGLY.
